title: L11 — TEAM ships ATR-based exit function (TP proposal + Acer exit-log schema + Forge code + iQuest review)

stages.prompt: Use wren_read_file with path='data/team_memory/shared/node_inbox/20260703T150000_tp_exit_geometry_proposal.json' — read TP's exit-geometry proposal. STAGE_OUT: quote the CONVERGENT FIX section verbatim (2-3 lines).

Use wren_curl to POST http://192.168.1.74:9001/ with body='{"message":"Give me the EXIT LOG schema — one line per field, python dict style. Fields Ross wants: ts, worker_id, instrument, venue, pnl_gbp, exit_trigger (atr_stop|take_profit|time|manual), entry_ts, hold_seconds, atr_at_entry, atr_at_exit. Just the dict."}'. STAGE_OUT: Acer's reply verbatim.

Use wren_dispatch_f46_team worker='forge' task='Write ONLY 12 lines of Python. Function compute_atr(bars, period=14) -> float that computes Average True Range from a list of (high, low, close) tuples. Then function apply_dynamic_exit(position, atr, multiplier=1.5) that returns dict {stop, take_profit} from entry_price using ATR × multiplier. No prose. No markdown backticks.'. STAGE_OUT: paste Forge's code.

Use wren_write_file with path='data/team_sandbox/L11_atr_exits.py' and content that combines: (a) docstring '"""L11 — ATR exits · TP proposal · Acer schema · Forge code."""', (b) blank line, (c) Forge's Python from prior stage. STAGE_OUT: tool result showing bytes written.

Use wren_dispatch_iquest task='In 2 lines: given ATR computes from (high,low,close) bars and apply_dynamic_exit returns stop=entry-ATR*mult, TP=entry+ATR*mult — is there an edge case for zero-range bars (H=L=C) or negative direction? Just yes/no + one-line fix if yes.'. STAGE_OUT: iQuest's review verbatim.

Given all prior stages: does the L11 exit-fix pass the exit gate? In ONE line: 'L11 VERDICT: shipped_to_sandbox=<yes|no>, syntax=<pass|fail>, smoke=<pass|fail>, iquest_veto=<yes|no>, ready_for_prod=<yes|no>'.
